entries.subject: Radius adopted from the published record
entries.finding: Radius: Limb-darkened angular diameter 20.58 ± 0.03 mas, or 44.2 ± 0.9 solar radii, from lunar occultations and VLTI/VINCI by Richichi and Roccatagliata (2005), A&A 433, 305. Adopted 30,749,940 km, 44.2000 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is adopted. Placement: SIMBAD basic record for * alf Tau (HIP 21421), ICRS J2000 position, reference 2007A&A...474..653V, retrieved 2026-09-21: https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=alf+Tau; Inverse of the Hipparcos new-reduction parallax 48.94 ± 0.77 mas (van Leeuwen 2007) via SIMBAD.
